text: 过去有个罪名叫非法同居，

text: 性行为并不会因为包月收费就高尚，

text: 甚至不能因为免费而无辜。

text: 是否合法的唯一判定标准就是统治阶级当时的主要利益。

text: 作为一个社会主义国家。

text: 只要国体不变，卖淫就不可能走上前台。

text: 等到他们的女儿、妻子被人贩子卖掉之后他们才会醒悟过来禁止卖淫到底保护了谁。
en: Only after their daughters and wives are sold by human traffickers will they realise who the ban on prostitution ultimately protects.

text: 不用反驳啊，反正是不可能的。

text: 很多类人生物对社会主义中国的“人人平等，消灭剥削和压迫”这句话的理解有偏差。
en: Many humanoid creatures misunderstand the phrase of socialist China, “everyone is equal, and exploitation and oppression are abolished”.

text: 你以为喊口号呢在？

text: 但是你私下干归你私下干，你别来回跳，没抓到你算你运气好，这事就是不允许摆在明面上，因为摆在明面上就是相当于否定这个国家的最基本的根基：社会主义。
en: But go ahead and do it in private if you must; just don’t keep jumping back and forth. If you weren’t caught, consider yourself lucky—this simply cannot be put out in the open, because doing so would amount to denying the most fundamental foundation of this country: socialism.

text: 这是合法性的问题，是红线问题，所以说什么合法化，做你的大头梦去。

text: 四川亮点茶楼案是比较大的。

text: 然后只要有女性失业，社区就推荐她去做这个职业。

text: 可以有很多角度反驳的。

text: 我为什么要支持一个素不相识的人去打倒另一个素不相识的人呢？
en: Why should I support a total stranger in bringing down another total stranger?

text: 如果是二十年前，我会告诉我自己，我现在要帮助的这个人，也是某个母亲的孩子，也是某个家庭的至亲，也是个有血有肉知道疼的大活人。
en: If this were twenty years ago, I would tell myself that the person I am now helping is also the child of some mother, also the closest kin of some family, also a flesh-and-blood living person who feels pain.

text: 如果我遇到相同的处境，我当然也希望别人和我站在同一战线上。
en: If I were in the same situation, of course I too would hope that others would stand on the same side as me.

text: 而现在是2023年，我很清醒的认识到——
en: But now it is 2023, and I have come to a sober realisation—

text: 我要帮助某个人，这个人很有可能转眼就忘了我是谁，ta很有可能在另一个问题上公开放我的地图炮，抓住我的一个弱点公然地嘲讽我、奚落我，试图令我社死。
en: The person I help might very well forget who I am in the blink of an eye; they might very well, on another issue, publicly turn their map cannon on me, seize on a weakness of mine and openly mock me, ridicule me, and try to bring about my social death.

text: 也可能ta平时干不少割韭菜骗钱的买卖，搞不好某个令我深恶痛绝的营销套路就是ta在执行的。
en: They might also, in ordinary times, do quite a few deals that fleece people for money; it is quite possible that some marketing scheme I utterly detest is being run by them.

text: ta也有可能当我面时盛赞我乐于助人的高尚人品，背地里就教育自己家人千万不要学我，而是要巧妙地利用我来为其所用。

en: Both prostitution and obscenity and “press-ganging” involve a very deadly problem————human trafficking!

en: Therefore the law must guard this bottom line; one cannot act in this way.

en: Do it and you go to prison.

text: 生理和心理需求很多情况下不会交叉，而是各自平行。
en: Physiological and psychological needs, in many cases, do not intersect but run parallel to each other.

text: 性心理满足也能高潮，不见得一定要生理性交。
en: Sexual psychological satisfaction can also bring climax; it does not necessarily require physiological intercourse.

text: 所以将生理满足和心理满足混为一谈，这是荒谬的。
en: Therefore, conflating physiological satisfaction with psychological satisfaction is absurd.

text: 卖淫合法化不会解决强奸问题。
en: The legalisation of prostitution will not solve the problem of rape.

text: 从娼妓诞生的那一刻开始，这就是一个行业，有组织者和行业规模。
en: From the very moment prostitution came into being, it has been an industry, with organisers and an industry scale.

text: 卖淫合法化，必然带来的就是行业合法化。
en: The legalisation of prostitution inevitably brings with it the legalisation of the industry.

text: 现代卖淫行业合法化后，这些资金去向成谜。
en: After the modern prostitution industry is legalised, the whereabouts of these funds becomes a mystery.

text: 卖淫行业最容易滋生的就是黑社会，用暴力控制卖淫妇女。
en: What the prostitution industry most easily breeds is the underworld, which uses violence to control prostituted women.

text: 黑社会有了合法资金来源，必然会反过来危害正常合法社会。
en: Once the underworld has a legal source of funds, it will inevitably turn around and harm normal, lawful society.

text: 这条路实际上以前走过，并不是一开始就坚决打击卖淫集团。
en: This path was in fact travelled before; we did not from the very start resolutely crack down on prostitution rings.

text: 比如十年前的天上人间，东莞卖淫正规化。
en: For example, ten years ago there was Tian Shang Ren Jian, and Dongguan’s prostitution was formalised.

en: All of this was done, experimented with, and it was not a short period—there was an observation process of roughly twenty years in total.

text: 很多人就不知道九十年代红灯区之多，豪华夜总会之堂而皇之。
en: Many people simply do not know how numerous the red-light districts were in the nineties, how brazenly the lavish nightclubs operated.

text: 我以前住过一个小区。
en: I once lived in a residential community.

text: 从早上到下午四五点钟，整个社区死气沉沉，绝大部分店面都是关着门的。
en: From morning until four or five in the afternoon, the whole community was dead and lifeless, with the vast majority of shops closed.

text: 一旦到了吃晚饭时间，霓虹灯之耀眼，来往的汽车摩托车鳞次栉比，各种打扮妖艳的女性摩登上场，堵得水泄不通。

en: Those who came by car were mostly clients, while those on motorcycles were “motorbike taxis” specially there to ferry these women from one venue to another.

text: 非常红火。

en: What you saw was a kind of prosperity, but what was surging beneath the surface, that remained unknown.

text: 就这样的繁华下，黑社会的规模大得惊人，因为他们有资金来源。
en: Beneath such prosperity, the scale of the underworld was staggering, because they had a source of funds.

en: In normal social industry competition, what can you do?

en: The simplest logic is to physically eliminate the more successful competitors and monopolise the area alone.

text: 各种治安案件，枪击案件，甚至活埋，肢解案件层出不穷。
en: All kinds of public-order cases, shootings, even live burials and dismemberment cases emerged one after another without end.

text: 这个行业的竞争就是不择手段。
en: Competition in this industry stops at nothing.

text: 前面说的卖淫女转场。
en: As mentioned earlier, the prostituted women move between venues.

text: 一般的卖淫女当然无所谓，可以在不同的夜场转来转去。
en: Ordinary prostituted women, of course, do not mind and can move around between different night venues.

text: 好的优质卖淫女，这就是资源，这就是利润。
en: The good, high-quality prostituted women—they are a resource, they are profit.

text: 敢转场就会被殴打，胁迫，轮奸。

text: 在这个行业下，卖淫女根本就不要幻想有什么自由。

text: 总之，社会弊端极大。
en: In short, the social ills are enormous.

text: 要铲除黑社会，就要铲除卖淫行业。
en: To uproot the underworld, one must uproot the prostitution industry.

text: 此后就是重拳出击，一锅端。

text: 卖淫行业被铲除之后，组织卖淫者被严惩之后，一些偷偷摸摸以卖淫为生的人，反到是有了保障。
en: After the prostitution industry was eradicated and those who organised prostitution were severely punished, some who surreptitiously made a living from prostitution actually gained a measure of security.

text: 因为组织胁迫被严厉打击，自由卖淫就有了更多自主权。

en: As for the harms, some people, for their own benefit, even dare to claim that drugs are not all that harmful.

text: 互联网上，那有多少良心，想着自己的好处才是真的。
en: On the internet, how much conscience is there? Thinking of one’s own benefit is what truly counts.
